A '''[[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]]''' was present on a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Weequay pirate ship/Legends|pirate ship]], the [[Marauder (Weequay pirate ship)/Legends|''Marauder'']], during the events of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was used for entertainment as a gladiator droid and fought [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droid]] [[K0-5D/Legends|K0-5D]].

K0-5D destroyed this droid with relative ease and used his built-in [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] to set fire to his remains.
